report.headline: S0003: Amber · coverage 85 % · critical: delivery

claims.text: Microchip (S0003) has an overall amber risk rating with a total score of 36.0 and 85% coverage; delivery is the only critical signal.
Delivery performance is poor: on-time rate of 32% over the last 6 months across 57 deliveries with 6 overdue undelivered, down from 73% in the prior 6 months.
Concentration risk is low: zero single-source parts (A, B, or C) and 0 of 17 open orders are on single-source parts.
Financial health appears stable: revenue grew 7.1% year-over-year to $4.713 billion in the latest fiscal year from $4.402 billion in the previous fiscal year.
Country risk (Poland) is moderate: unemployment rose 0.20 percentage points and HICP inflation rose 0.68 pp over the latest 6 months versus the prior 6 months.
Weather risk could not be assessed because NOAA data is not onboarded.
